quirks: query and agent_id are BOTH required query-string params; omitting either will likely 4xx
Results are scoped per agent_id — a fresh/unknown agent_id returns {success:true,results:[],count:0}. You must have stored memories under that same agent_id first to get hits.
This is the semantic-retrieval (read) endpoint only; it does not store memories.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.memoryapi.org/x402/memory with required query params query (natural-language search) and agent_id (your stable agent identifier), plus optional limit (default 5). Pay $0.001 USDC on Base via x402. The response is JSON: read body.results[] for the matched memory items and body.count for how many were returned. Use the same agent_id you stored memories under, otherwise results will be empty.
